A_general.open_code_note: The public getsentry/toolkit repository contains the shared MCP core and the hosted Cloudflare transport, as well as a separate stdio package for self-hosted deployments. Hosted docs and repository describe the remote service; the exact deployed revision and runtime configuration were not independently verified. The core definitions are therefore used for tool names and schemas, with hosted availability marked where appropriate.
A_general.mcp_protocol_version: NOT FOUND (the server negotiates MCP protocol versions; the repository uses @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.0)
other_official_servers: https://mcp.sentry.dev/sse — legacy SSE endpoint; returned HTTP 410 during evidence collection. Repository says to use HTTP transport at /mcp.
Local stdio server distributed as @sentry/mcp-server — separate transport intended to support self-hosted Sentry; its tools share the MCP core.
An independent Docs MCP Worker is described in the repository as providing documentation search and AI-generated answers; it is not the input endpoint.

B_access_pricing.mcp_access_cost_details: No MCP-specific fee or limit was found in the hosted documentation. The official pricing page was not retrievable during this review; official help-center search results direct users to https://sentry.io/pricing/ for plan pricing.
B_access_pricing.linked_software_cost: The official pricing page is the source for current plan amounts; it could not be read during this review. Search results for the official Sentry Help Center describe Developer as free and refer to the pricing page for plan estimates. Do not treat MCP itself as separately priced based on this evidence.
B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: Sentry pricing and usage quotas apply to the linked Sentry service. No MCP-specific per-call charge was found.
B_access_pricing.other_access_restrictions: Hosted connections use OAuth. OAuth metadata advertises org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write. The service supports optional organization- and project-scoped URL paths and an experimental=1 query parameter. Hosted tool availability can also depend on granted skills and constraints.
B_access_pricing.restrictions_controlled_by: Vendor controls the hosted endpoint, OAuth metadata, and server-side exposure; the user authorizes a Sentry account; Sentry organization permissions also constrain API operations.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: Hosted docs document tool exposure without enumerating the list. Skills, scope constraints, and URL constraints filter exposure.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: No MCP sampling request or sampling capability declaration was located in reviewed server code or hosted documentation.
No MCP roots capability or roots request handling was located in reviewed sources.

The endpoint returned HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate Bearer and resource_metadata=https://mcp.sentry.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. That metadata returned resource=https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp, authorization_servers=[https://mcp.sentry.dev], scopes_supported=[org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write], bearer_methods_supported=[header]. Authorization-server metadata advertises authorization_endpoint=https://mcp.sentry.dev/oauth/authorize, token_endpoint=https://mcp.sentry.dev/oauth/token, registration_endpoint=https://mcp.sentry.dev/oauth/register, response_types_supported=[code], response_modes_supported=[query], grant_types_supported=[authorization_code, refresh_token], token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported=[client_secret_basic, client_secret_post, none], revocation_endpoint=https://mcp.sentry.dev/oauth/token, code_challenge_methods_supported=[S256], authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported=true, client_id_metadata_document_supported=true. Repository documents 30-day refresh-token TTL. The unscoped protected-resource URL and OpenID configuration returned 404.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: HTTP 401 challenge for unauthenticated endpoint requests; successful authorized MCP response structure not observed.
C_capabilities.authorization_mechanism: Metadata Doc; Dynamic Client Registration; authorization-code flow with refresh tokens; PKCE S256; token auth methods client_secret_basic, client_secret_post, none; scopes_supported: org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write; refreshTokenTTL is 30 days in public code; OAuth revocation endpoint is /oauth/token. The challenge and metadata values above are from the prefetched raw responses.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. [LOCAL CODE @17833f7] Tool modules declare readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, and openWorldHint; idempotentHint is optional. The definitions JSON does not preserve annotations. The server registers annotations with tools. Tool list includes read and mutating operations. 2. [LOCAL CODE @17833f7] Several tool descriptions recommend explicit user approval or workflow sequencing; these instructions are not generic server-enforced confirmation gates. OAuth consent is enforced for remote authorization, but is not a per-tool confirmation. 3. [OAUTH METADATA] Scopes: org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write. The remote OAuth flow grants access to the user's Sentry account and is constrained by upstream permissions. Public code sets a 30-day refresh-token TTL. DCR and client ID metadata documents are supported; PKCE S256 is advertised. Redirect URI details are in OAuth code. 4. [DOCS/LOCAL CODE] Endpoint paths support organization/project scoping; project scope is recommended. Docs expose experimental=1. Skills filter tools; constrained sessions hide discovery tools that would escape or duplicate scope. Repository describes skill options for local/stdio and direct remote token usage; those options are not all documented on the hosted page. 5. No general MCP-specific PII masking or field exclusion policy was found. DPA/privacy documents govern Sentry service data generally; tool-specific output filtering depends on tool implementations. 6. [LOCAL CODE] Cloudflare applies IP-based rate limiting to /mcp and /oauth; exact thresholds are deployment configuration and not published in reviewed sources. Some tools impose schema limits (e.g., comment text max 4096 characters); no general result truncation cap was found. 7. [LOCAL CODE] Input schemas validate typed/required fields and selected bounds. Scope constraints are injected into tool parameters. Further automatic correction is tool-specific; embedded search agents may repair query parameters. 8. [LOCAL CODE] Server adds client, transport, experimental-mode, constraint, and skill attributes to spans; errors and some failures are logged to Sentry telemetry. Public sources do not specify hosted telemetry opt-out or retention. 9. Tool names/descriptions were searched for feedback, rating, report, survey, and suggestion terms. No vendor feedback/rating tool or MCP-specific upsell message was identified. Tools for retrieving user reports concern Sentry product data. 10. Server exposes skill-filtered tools; a Claude Code plugin/subagent is distributed outside the MCP endpoint. Tool instructions include behavior recommendations that clients may follow but which are not necessarily enforced by handlers. 11. [LOCAL CODE] OAuth/client and token state is stored for authorization and refresh. No evidence found that past agent tool behavior changes future tool output or availability. 12. [LOCAL CODE] The top-level endpoint uses a two-stage tool structure: catalog tools are found with search_sentry_tools and invoked using execute_sentry_tool. This is a dynamically discoverable catalog within one MCP server. Seer invokes Sentry's AI analysis service. 13. No arbitrary SQL, shell, script, or general raw API request tool was identified. execute_sentry_tool invokes catalogued Sentry MCP tools and is a broad dispatcher, not a documented arbitrary API escape hatch.
behavioural_instructions_to_ai_verbatim: When scoped, tools automatically default to the constrained org/project and unnecessary discovery tools are hidden. Scoping to a project is recommended when possible.
Do NOT call this tool as an automatic follow-up to get_sentry_resource.
Pass Sentry URLs unchanged to issueUrl or url parameters — NEVER try to fetch Sentry URLs via HTTP directly, always use the MCP tools which handle authentication.
For any Sentry-related operation that is not directly listed as a tool, treat it as a Sentry tool. Use search_sentry_tools only when you need to discover the tool name or schema.
Chain multiple tool calls when a request requires it.
D_server_side_logic.server_structure_explanation: The server exposes a top-level set of tools and a larger catalog that agents search and dispatch through search_sentry_tools and execute_sentry_tool. Organization/project constraints and skill selections also change tool availability.

E_aggregated.action_count_comment: Official tool definitions exist in the public getsentry/toolkit repository at packages/mcp-core/src/toolDefinitions.json; 76 names were extracted (15 direct tools and 61 catalog tools). The hosted docs do not state a total. Catalog tools are discoverable and invoked through the official search/execute tools, subject to skills and constraints. No third-party catalog actions were added. Glama's hosted connector did not yield a stable complete inventory; its older @getsentry/sentry-mcp entry is a separate catalog entry. Composio's Sentry API toolkit reports 209 proxy/API actions and its Sentry MCP toolkit reports 9 wrapper tools; neither is used to replace or augment the native repository list.
